home.when: the search box, my favourite and recent objects, my workbenches and their expiry, change sets awaiting me, drafts not yet observed applied, my open windows; a DBA's blocked sessions and findings; an admin's unclassified databases, pending grants, window requests, the door's state and the freeze switch

me.when: who I am here: my roles and rights, my levels on each database, my open windows

my-trail.when: my own trail here: what I ran, changed, drafted and opened, on which databases

databases-list.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
databases-list.when: every database I may see, as cards by class: name, application, size, colour, private flag, grants state

database-view.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
database-view.when: one database's overview: version, size by schema, extensions against their defaults, non-default settings, my level, its verb tabs

schema-view.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
schema-view.when: one schema: its object families with counts

family-list.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
family-list.when: a paged, filtered table of one family's objects

object-view.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
object-view.when: one object's page: its tabs — a table's columns, constraints, indexes, triggers, policies and partitions; the danger zone at the foot

search.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
search.when: where is the object called X — names, columns, types and comments across every database I may see

favourites.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)

registry-list.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
registry-list.when: every database the cluster has, proposed and confirmed classes, the root step still owed while grants are pending

registry-entry.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
registry-entry.when: one database's registry entry: class, application, private flag, colour, label, hidden, notes, grants per table

access-list.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
access-list.when: who holds which level on which database, people and roles

access-target.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
access-target.when: one database's levels: grant masked or rows to a person or a role, revoke

classifications.section: The estate, access and the object browser (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
classifications.when: the columns of a database classified secret or personal, proposed or confirmed, to confirm or clear

object-ddl.when: an object's DDL with its commented DROP, to copy or open in the editor

object-dependencies.when: what this object depends on and what depends on it

object-impact.when: what breaks if I drop or alter this object or column: the full reach of CASCADE, the views to drop and recreate in order

object-privileges.when: who may do what on this object, its owner and the default privileges that apply

object-statistics.when: a table's or an index's size, row estimate, scans, dead tuples, last vacuum and analyze, column statistics

join-path.when: how two tables join: the shortest foreign-key path with its column pairs, emitted as a JOIN into the editor

roles-list.when: the cluster's roles with their attributes (read-only)

role-view.when: one role: attributes, memberships with their inherit and set options, effective privileges per database

sql.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
sql.when: the editor on one database: Run, Explain, Format, Cancel; results with the cap and the masks said; messages with the error marker

sql-history.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
sql-history.when: my runs (an auditor's: everyone's), searchable by database, class, outcome and text

query-run.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
query-run.when: one run: its statements, each statement's status, rows, notices and time, the tier and level it ran at

saved-list.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
saved-list.when: saved queries, verified first, mine and shared

saved-view.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
saved-view.when: one saved query, its parameters and its verification — never run implicitly

saved-add.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
saved-add.when: to save a query: title, the SQL, named parameters, the database, shared or private

saved-edit.section: The SQL workspace (slice 3 — the first exemplar)
saved-edit.when: to change a saved query (the verification drops by itself when the SQL changes)

workbenches-list.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
workbenches-list.when: the workbenches: mine, and every workbench for an admin — cloned from what, size against quota, expiring when

workbench-add.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
workbench-add.when: a new workbench: empty or a schema-only clone of a database I may see

workbench-view.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
workbench-view.when: one workbench: its change log, renew, export as a migration, import a CSV, reset its credential, drop

workbench-import.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
workbench-import.when: (the same file answers `workbench_import`'s POST) to load a CSV into a workbench table: the preview, the column mapping, ON_ERROR for type errors

change-form.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
change-form.when: a form to create, alter or drop a schema, table, column, constraint, index, view, materialized view, sequence, function, procedure, trigger, type, domain, enum, policy or comment — submit is Review

changes-list.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
changes-list.when: the change log: change sets proposed, reviewed, rehearsed, applied, drafted, discarded or failed

change-review.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
change-review.when: Change review: the SQL, each statement's lock, rewrite and scan with its source, lint, the literals list, Rehearse, the one button the class allows

change-edit.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
change-edit.when: to edit a draft change set's title and statements before review

rehearsal-view.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
rehearsal-view.when: what a rehearsal measured: per statement the locks taken, whether it rewrote, its time, errors

drafts-list.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
drafts-list.when: migration drafts as cards per application, observed applied or not

draft-view.section: Workbenches, forms, change review and migration drafts (slice 4 — the second exemplar)
draft-view.when: one draft: the file, Download, Copy, the observed-applied state

grid.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
grid.when: a table's rows at my level: filters, sort, the generated SQL shown, the pending bar

row-view.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
row-view.when: one row as a full page: values with NULL, empty and DEFAULT distinct, the rows that reference it grouped by foreign key

row-add.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
row-add.when: to stage a new row: foreign keys through the record picker, generated columns read-only

row-edit.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
row-edit.when: to stage a change to one row; a value I did not change is never written back

review-rows.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
review-rows.when: a change set's rows before Apply: new, changed and deleted, each against its before-image

conflict.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
conflict.when: a row that changed since I staged it: mine, theirs, keep or drop

windows-list.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
windows-list.when: my windows, and for a super-admin every request awaiting approval and every window open

window-add.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
window-add.when: to ask for a read or a write window on one database: mode, minutes, reason — a fresh sign-on first if the last is older than 10 minutes

window-view.section: Data: the grid, the row page, change sets of rows and windows (slice 5)
window-view.when: one window: who, where, why, who approved, its time left, what it applied

plans-list.when: the plans I kept, with their queries and comments

plan-view.when: one plan: the server-rendered tree with the flags first; PEV2 at 1280

sessions.when: what is running now across the databases I may see: sessions running, waiting and blocking, the root blocker, texts normalized

session-view.when: one session: its normalized text, waits, the locks it holds and waits on, whom it blocks; cancel and terminate

locks.when: the locks held and awaited, linked to sessions and objects

statements.when: the top statements by total time, mean time, calls, rows and I/O, each linking to Explain

server.when: the server's I/O, checkpointer, WAL and archiver panels

vacuum.when: the vacuum and wraparound panel: table ages, dead tuples, last vacuum and analyze, sessions holding the horizon

maintenance-list.when: maintenance jobs queued, running with their progress, and finished

maintenance-add.when: to queue VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX CONCURRENTLY or REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY — the lock it takes said first

health-all.when: health findings across the databases I may see, by severity

db-health.when: one database's findings, each with its fix as a change set

bloat.when: bloat estimates for tables and indexes (exact where pgstattuple is installed)

index-advice.when: unused, duplicate, overlapping and invalid indexes; foreign keys without one

db-history.when: what changed in this database since a date, each change attributed to a change set, a draft, the grants service, or unexplained

object-history.when: how an object's definition changed, snapshot by snapshot, with the diff

drift.when: unexplained changes across the databases — hand changes nobody made through the tool

compare.when: two databases, a database and a workbench, or one database at two snapshots: the inventory and per-object diffs

compare-object.when: one object's normalized DDL on both sides, as a diff

diagram.when: a focused ER diagram: start from a table, add hops, choose the detail — the list of foreign keys at 375

backups.when: each database's last recorded backup and WAL archiving state

memory-estate.when: every memory database: placement, size, the extension's version against the host's, each tenant's facade version, flags, the owner's printed steps

memory-tenant.when: one memory tenant's health: counts, the embedding backlog and its age, never-indexed documents, the extraction queue, failing facades, configured models

memory-episodes.when: episode counts by kind, application, day, sensitivity and scope — never a payload

memory-graph-stats.when: the graph's shape: stores, relations, node types, god-node counts, communities and import namespaces

memory-config.when: the tenant's models (provider, alias, the secret's name — never a value), skills and the facade reference

memory-isolation.when: the isolation audit: database CONNECT grants, maludb group members, BYPASSRLS logins, FORCE RLS state

memory-graph.when: the graph explorer: subject search, a subject's page, neighbours, a bounded walk, a path — every view logged

memory-documents.when: document, chat and note metadata: source type, namespace, size, indexed when

proposals.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
proposals.when: what the agents proposed — change sets, drafts and notes — and what became of each

notes-list.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
notes-list.when: the DBA notes the Advisor posted, newest first

note-view.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
note-view.when: one DBA note with its proposals

exports-list.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
exports-list.when: my exports: made, waiting, ready to download once, expired

notifications.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)

notification-prefs.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
notification-prefs.when: which notices reach me, in-app and by text (opt-in)

admin-settings.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-settings.when: the tool's limits, caps, retention and expiry

audit.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
audit.when: every run through the door, by person, agent, database, class and outcome

audit-run.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
audit-run.when: one run in full: the SQL (while kept), each statement, the tier, the level, the window

audit-reveals.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
audit-reveals.when: who unmasked, opened a window on or revealed what, when and why

admin-door.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-door.when: the door: its pool, waits, refusals today by rule, its version and libpg_query's

admin-grants.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-grants.when: the grants service: its last pass per database, columns pending, tables not granted to the tool

admin-agents.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-agents.when: the tool's agents: their roles, the targets they may read, their dispatches

admin-worker.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-worker.when: the worker's passes and their outcomes

admin-freeze.section: Agents, exports, notifications, home and admin (slice 10)
admin-freeze.when: the freeze switch and its history
